'''Rengor Talke''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] serving on the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].

==Biography==
Rengor Talke was a large, threatening slave fighter on a planet visited by the ''Wanderer''{{'s}} crew. Impressed with his abilities, the crew adopted Talke into their group, where he becoming a valuable crew mate.

==Personality and traits==
Talke was quiet and methodical, but frightening when enraged.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'' {{1st}}
